echo -e 'opcache.enable=1
opcache.memory_consumption=256
opcache.max_accelerated_files=10000
opcache.revalidate_freq=2' > /etc/php/8.2/mods-available/opcache.ini && phpenmod opcache && systemctl restart apache2

instruction: Install and configure Memcached for PHP sessions
output: apt install -y memcached php-memcached && sed -i 's/-l 127.0.0.1/-l 0.0.0.0/' /etc/memcached.conf && systemctl restart memcached

apt install -y redis-server php-redis && sed -i 's/session.save_handler = files/session.save_handler = redis/' /etc/php/8.2/cli/php.ini && echo 'session.save_path = "tcp://127.0.0.1:6379"' >> /etc/php/8.2/cli/php.ini && systemctl restart php8.2-fpm

instruction: Set up Nginx with Lua scripting (OpenResty)
output: apt install -y nginx-extras && echo -e 'location /hello {\n  content_by_lua_block { ngx.say("Hello from Lua") }\n}' >> /etc/nginx/sites-available/default && nginx -s reload

instruction: Use njs (Nginx JavaScript) for request processing
output: apt install -y nginx-module-njs && echo -e 'js_import /etc/nginx/script.js;\njs_set $greeting greeting;\nserver { return 200 $greeting; }' >> /etc/nginx/nginx.conf && nginx -s reload

instruction: Set up Nginx with PageSpeed module
output: apt install -y nginx-module-pagespeed && echo -e 'pagespeed On;\npagespeed FileCachePath /var/cache/ngx_pagespeed;\npagespeed EnableFilters combine_css,combine_javascript;' > /etc/nginx/pagespeed.conf && nginx -s reload

instruction: Create a Traefik dynamic config for a service

output:
apt install -y envoyproxy && cat > /etc/envoy/envoy.yaml << 'EOF'
static_resources:
  listeners:
  - address: { socket_address: { address: 0.0.0.0, port_value: 10000 } }
    filter_chains:
    - filters:
      - name: envoy.filters.network.http_connection_manager
        typed_config:
          "@type": type.googleapis.com/envoy.extensions.filters.network.http_connection_manager.v3.HttpConnectionManager
          stat_prefix: ingress_http
          route_config:
            virtual_hosts:
            - name: backend
              domains: ["*"]
              routes:
              - match: { prefix: "/" }
                route: { cluster: backend }
          http_filters:
          - name: envoy.filters.http.router
  clusters:
  - name: backend
    type: STRICT_DNS
    lb_policy: ROUND_ROBIN
    load_assignment:
      cluster_name: backend
      endpoints:
      - lb_endpoints:
        - endpoint:
            address: { socket_address: { address: 127.0.0.1, port_value: 8080 } }
EOF && envoy --config-path /etc/envoy/envoy.yaml &
